properties.method: PM7 (Gaussian 16 RevC.01, unrestricted UPM7, gas phase)
properties.lowest_singlet_character: open-shell (diradical) singlet, 1A2: two singly occupied orbitals - an in-plane N-centred sp2 lone pair (n) and a ring-delocalised pi* orbital - coupled to S=0 (S**2 = 0); the closed-shell zwitterionic 1A1 lies 46.0 kcal/mol above the triplet and is a saddle point (one imaginary frequency, -485.7 cm-1)
properties.gap_definition: adiabatic: E(1A2 minimum, PM7/CIS) - E(3A2 minimum, PM7/UHF)
properties.gap_accuracy_note: PM7 overestimates the n-pi exchange splitting by roughly a factor of two relative to the experimental/DFT consensus adiabatic gap (ca. 18 kcal/mol); the ordering (triplet lower) and the open-shell character are robust. A broken-symmetry unrestricted singlet is not reachable here (UHF/UPM7 route tokens are outside the permitted method tokens), so the singlet was characterized with the spin-adapted PM7 CIS treatment.

properties.method: PM7 CIS (Gaussian 16, CIS=(NStates=4,Root=2,50-50) on the closed-shell PM7 reference), gas phase
properties.dominant_configuration: HOMO(17) -> LUMO(18) = 0.65, HOMO(17) -> 20 = -0.26 (HOMO = in-plane N lone pair n, LUMO = ring pi*)
properties.frequencies_note: 30 real CIS frequencies, no imaginary mode (a 4221 cm-1 artefact reflects the limited numerical quality of the semiempirical CIS Hessian)
properties.geometry_note: planar N (C2v), C1-N = 1.305 A, slight Kekule alternation of the ring C-C bonds

properties.frequencies_note: one imaginary frequency -485.7 cm-1 (ring deformation): stationary point is a saddle, not a minimum

edges.channel: electronic state change (spin flip within the same (n,pi*) configuration)
electronic state change to the closed-shell zwitterionic configuration
